boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented Maine Maritime Academy study environments, centered on Nutting Memorial Library and academic-support spaces in Castine.

cards.title: Nutting Memorial Library
cards.subtitle: Platz Hall · three levels of work and study space
cards.notes: Start here when you need a flexible library base; choose a level and settle in with course reserves, research materials, or your own work.
cards.short_summary: The campus library’s three levels provide varied work and study settings.
cards.evidence_claim: Maine Maritime states that Nutting Memorial Library, in Platz Hall, has three levels with a variety of work and study spaces.
cards.source_title: The Campus — Maine Maritime Academy Undergraduate Catalog
cards.access_notes: Semester library hours listed by MMA are Mon–Thu 8 a.m.–10 p.m., Fri 8 a.m.–4 p.m., and Sun noon–10 p.m.; closed Saturday.

cards.entity_name: Nutting Memorial Library Upper Level Quiet Study
cards.title: Upper-Level Quiet Study
cards.subtitle: Nutting Memorial Library · Platz Hall
cards.notes: Bring reading or detail-focused work to the upper level, which MMA specifically identifies for quiet study.
cards.short_summary: A designated quiet-study setting on the library’s upper level.
cards.evidence_claim: MMA’s student information identifies quiet study on Nutting Memorial Library’s upper level.
cards.access_notes: Use during posted library hours; MMA lists semester hours in its library information.

cards.title: Noise-Friendly Main Level
cards.subtitle: Nutting Memorial Library · Platz Hall
cards.notes: Use the main level when your task involves conversation or a little ambient sound; MMA labels this level noise-friendly.
cards.short_summary: A library level intended for work that does not require silence.
cards.evidence_claim: MMA’s student information identifies Nutting Memorial Library’s main level as noise-friendly.
cards.access_notes: Use during posted library hours; MMA lists semester hours in its library information.

cards.entity_name: Nutting Memorial Library Reservable Group Spaces
cards.title: Reservable Group Spaces
cards.subtitle: Nutting Memorial Library · Platz Hall
cards.notes: Plan collaborative work here and confirm reservation details with the library before relying on a particular group space.
cards.short_summary: Reservable spaces for collaborative study in the campus library.
cards.evidence_claim: MMA’s student information lists reservable group spaces at Nutting Memorial Library.
cards.access_notes: Reservation procedures are not stated on the cited page; contact Nutting Memorial Library to confirm availability.

cards.title: Harbor-View Armchairs
cards.subtitle: Nutting Memorial Library · Platz Hall
cards.notes: Choose an armchair with a harbor view for independent reading, then keep the setup simple with materials you can use from a chair.
cards.short_summary: Library armchairs paired with a documented view of the harbor.
cards.evidence_claim: MMA’s student information lists armchairs with a view of the harbor among Nutting Memorial Library’s study spaces.
cards.access_notes: Use during posted library hours; MMA lists semester hours in its library information.

cards.entity_name: Nutting Memorial Library Cozy-Corner Single Desks
cards.title: Cozy-Corner Single Desks
cards.subtitle: Nutting Memorial Library · Platz Hall
cards.notes: Set up solo work at one of the library’s single desks in a cozy corner when you want a compact, individual workspace.
cards.short_summary: Individual desks in a cozy-corner library setting.
cards.evidence_claim: MMA’s student information lists single desks in a cozy corner at Nutting Memorial Library.
cards.access_notes: Use during posted library hours; MMA lists semester hours in its library information.

cards.title: Library Computer Lab
cards.subtitle: Nutting Memorial Library · Platz Hall
cards.notes: Use the computer lab when you need a campus workstation; bring your MMA ID because MMA specifies student access by ID card.
cards.short_summary: A student-access computer lab in Nutting Memorial Library.
cards.evidence_claim: MMA states that students can access Nutting Memorial Library’s computer lab 24 hours a day with their MMA ID cards.
cards.source_title: The Campus — Maine Maritime Academy Undergraduate Catalog
cards.access_notes: MMA states that students may access this computer lab 24 hours a day with MMA ID cards.

cards.title: Library Study Lounge
cards.subtitle: Nutting Memorial Library · Platz Hall
cards.notes: Use the study lounge for an after-hours library option, and carry your MMA ID for the access MMA describes.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour student study lounge in the campus library.
cards.evidence_claim: MMA states that students can access Nutting Memorial Library’s study lounge 24 hours a day with their MMA ID cards.
cards.source_title: The Campus — Maine Maritime Academy Undergraduate Catalog
cards.access_notes: MMA states that students may access this study lounge 24 hours a day with MMA ID cards.

cards.title: The Draft Deck Writing Center
cards.subtitle: Platz Hall · writing-support workspace
cards.notes: Bring a draft or research question to the Draft Deck; MMA identifies it as the writing center and locates it in Platz Hall.
cards.short_summary: MMA’s named writing center, located in Platz Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: MMA identifies The Draft Deck as its Writing Center and states that it is located in Platz Hall.
cards.access_notes: Contact the Writing Center director or Academic Support before visiting for assistance availability.

cards.entity_name: Buoy House Center for Student Success
cards.title: Buoy House Center for Student Success
cards.subtitle: 54 Pleasant Street · quiet, group, and academic-help options
cards.notes: Visit the Buoy House when you need study support, group-work space, or academic help; MMA invites students to drop in.
cards.short_summary: The Center for Student Success supports quiet study, group work, and academic help.
cards.evidence_claim: MMA says the Buoy House offers academic support, invites students seeking quiet study, 24-hour study, group work, or academic help to visit, and makes help free to enrolled students.
cards.access_notes: MMA invites students to drop in; its Testing Center at Buoy House is listed Monday–Friday, 8 a.m.–5 p.m. Confirm other services directly.
